items.title: 5.2.1 Testing aur debugging ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the importance of testing and debugging (PDF 64-65).

blocks.text: Testing aur debugging zaroori hain taake application har haal mein durust chale. Yeh software jaari hone se pehle ghaltiyan dhoond kar door karti hain; baqaida testing istemal ke dauran achanak nakami rokti hai, aur debugging ghalti ki wajah dhoond kar theek karti hai. Mil kar yeh aitbaar aur user ka bharosa barhati hain.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Aisi suraton par guftagu karein jahan ghaltiyan nakami ka sabab banti hain, aur samjhayein ke testing kyun ahem hai.

Testing jaanchti hai ke application apni zarooratein poori karti hai aur har function durust nataij deta hai. Yeh crash ya ghalat output ka khatra kam karti, aur tasdeeq karti hai ke tabdeeliyon ne pehle se chalti khusoosiyat nahi toreen. Achhi tarah test shuda applications zyada qabil-e-bharosa aur mustehkam hoti hain.
Programming ki aam ghaltiyan aur bugs

blocks.caption: Program ki ghaltiyon ki qismein
rows: Code zaban ke qawaid torta hai, is liye program bilkul nahi chalta
Colon ke baghair if x > 5: SyntaxError
Program chalte waqt na-durust amal hota hai aur woh ruk jata hai
a = 10; b = 0; result = a / b se ZeroDivisionError
Program chalta hai lekin ghalat nateeja deta hai
length * width ke bajaye area = length + width
Data ki ghaltiyan (ghalat ya bigra data) aur resource leaks (files ya connections kabhi band nahi)
Khuli chhoti file program khatam hone tak memory leti hai

blocks.alt: Program errors ki teen qismein. Logic Error: area = length + width se 8 aata hai jo ghalat nateeja hai; durust: area = length * width, output 15. Runtime Error: b = 0 ho to a / b par ZeroDivisionError: division by zero aur program beech mein ruk jata hai. Syntax Error: if x > 5 ke baad colon na ho to SyntaxError: invalid syntax; durust: if x > 5:.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.1: Logic, runtime aur syntax error ki misal (kitab ki Figure 5.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 5.1 ke 'Correct logic' khane mein bhi '# Output: 8 (incorrect result)' chhapa hai. Durust formula area = length * width se 5 x 3 = 15 aata hai, is liye yahan '# Output: 15' likha gaya hai. Logic error mein program chalta hai magar nateeja ghalat hota hai; runtime error program ko beech mein rok deta hai; syntax error mein program shuru hi nahi hota.

blocks.prompt: Do number ka average nikalne wala program 60 aur 80 ke liye 140 print karta hai. Yeh kis qism ki ghalti hai, aur ghaliban durusti kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Logic error: program chalta hai lekin nateeja ghalat hai. Ghaliban yeh jama karta hai aur 2 se taqseem nahi karta; durusti average = (a + b) / 2, jo 70 deta hai.

items: Testing jaari hone se pehle ghaltiyan dhoondti aur dekhti ke tabdeeli kuch na tore.
Syntax errors program chalne nahi dete; runtime errors beech mein rokte; logic errors ghalat nateeja dete.
Doosre bugs: data ki ghaltiyan, resource leaks.
